source.map: Map 8, Special Setbacks (page 8 of Washington County, North Bethany Subarea Plan of the Bethany Community Plan, Chapter 2 maps (chapter-2-north-bethany-subarea-plan-maps-11-2024), https://washingtoncountyor.gov/lut/planning/documents/chapter-2-north-bethany-subarea-plan-maps-11-2024/download, retrieved 2026-10-30, sha256 9c22e330fc22f4daeb9635dbb1cc5f7286cc38dfec8b2f934af3f8bcb5ae4a65). General Design Element 7 sends the reader to it: the build-to setbacks apply to designated areas along the Park Blocks and the Northeast Neighborhood Linear Park, and 'Relevant street segments are identified on the Special Setbacks Map'.

source.how: The sheet is an ArcGIS Pro GeoPDF: each map frame carries a /VP viewport with its CRS (NAD_1983_HARN_StatePlane_Oregon_North_FIPS_3601, feet = EPSG:2913) and four corner coordinates. The page-to-ground affine was fitted to those corners (residual 0.31 ft at each) and the map's own vector strokes were read out of the page by colour, so nothing was rendered, picked or flood-filled. Checked by laying the county's current taxlots over the result: the ASC outlines and the setback strokes run on the lot and right-of-way lines. Map 8 draws two things: green 'Park Blocks' strokes on the two couplet streets either side of the Park Blocks (and a short stub east of Kaiser Road), and a blue 'Linear Park - north side of road (Adjacent to R-15NB, R-24NB and NCC NB)' stroke along Road A (NW Shackelford Rd). The map marks street segments, not lots, so each R-15 NB and R-24 NB lot was asked whether it fronts a marked segment. INSIDE (whole lot drawn): within 75 ft of the stroke with no other taxlot between; for the linear park also a lot behind the linear park's own tract (a strip at most 40 ft deep that is itself first on the stroke), north of the stroke only, as the legend says. UNANSWERED (the half of the lot nearest the stroke drawn, so the screen leaves the fact open): the stroke runs more than 15 ft inside the lot (a mapped future street that will divide it), the lot sits within 10 ft of a segment's end, or it is within 115 ft with no whole lot between. OUTSIDE (not drawn): everything else.
